mapper.select: select cast(julianday('now') - julianday(created_at) as integer) from articles where id = #{articleId}

select A.slug, A.title, A.description, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id where AF.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id order by favoriteCount desc limit 10
